outcome.goal: Add a nightly cleanup job for expired sessions.
outcome.deliverable: The scheduled job and a note on what it removed in a dry run.

facts.text: Sessions expire 30 days after their last activity.
The scheduler already runs other nightly jobs at 02:00.

requirements.text: Remove only sessions older than 30 days.
Log the number of removed sessions each run.

authorized.text: adding the job to the existing scheduler.
running a dry run against the development database.

unresolved.text: The retention period for archived accounts.
Notification of users whose sessions are removed.
Whether to run the job in batches or in one statement.
Whether the job may run against the production database.
